name: Unmanned and normally unattended installations
principle: Small platforms, often just a well bay and helipad, operated remotely and visited for maintenance; an emergency shelter gives refuge if weather prevents crew return. They cost less than full platforms in shallow water, with examples in the Southern North Sea and off Western Australia.

process_steps.name: Remote control and monitoring from a host or shore
Periodic visits by helicopter or boat

advantages: Lower operating cost than a full platform
limitations: Article gives no counts or cost figures
Larger well work needs a rig

sources.note: Wikipedia, Normally unmanned installation, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
